name: asr_benchmark_de
description:
de_asr_benchmark - German ASR Benchmark Dataset (test only)
	

This dataset aggregates multiple German speech test sets with paired transcripts.
It is intended only as a benchmark and evaluation set, not for training or validation.

	
		
		Split
	


test: all examples combined from the listed sources.


	
		
		Fields
	


audio: audio file (various formats)
text: transcript (plain text)


	
		
		Sources
	


De_Distant_Speech_Data_Corpus_1415_Realtek (test subset)
Bundestag ASR -… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sarannair/asr_benchmark_de.
reputation: An aggregate collection of German ASR test sets frequently used as a held-out benchmark for German speech recognition systems.
